import pandas as pd


def _add_days(t, n):
    r = t + pd.DateOffset(days=n)
    if r.utcoffset() > t.utcoffset():  # spring forward: keep the elapsed 24h per day
        r = r + (r.utcoffset() - t.utcoffset())
    return r


def schedule(start, tz, n_days, count):
    """Repeat a job every `n_days` days from `start` (local time in `tz`)."""
    t0 = pd.Timestamp(start).tz_localize(tz)
    fmt = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %z"
    one_by_one = [_add_days(t0, k * n_days).strftime(fmt) for k in range(count)]
    as_index = [_add_days(t0, n_days).strftime(fmt) for _ in range(count)]
    return {"one_by_one": one_by_one, "as_index": as_index}
